_comment: Which region an area export reads its archives from: the region holding the centre of the box [west, south, east, north], else the first touching it, among the regions that declare heights, slope and contours; else null. `cases` are made-up boxes over NSW and the simulated regions. `madeUp` are made-up regions on a flat map (each a box [west, south, east, north] and the archives it declares) with boxes over them. Read by shared/src/areaExport.test.ts (areaExportRegion) and topo/tests/test_regions.py (TestExportRegion), so the API that names the grid and the worker that reads the archives cannot pick differently.

cases.why: centre off NSW's northern border, the box over it
centre off NSW's western border, the box over it
inside the heights' coverage box and all in Victoria
centre past simulated Utah's east edge, the box over it
centred in a region with no archives, over one that has them
centred in none, over two that have them: the first listed
centred in a later region that an earlier one also touches: the one holding the centre
inside a region with heights and contours but no slope
